seed: A recording opened at Next defaults, cut in half, and copied with Edit > Copy Video and Copy as GIF: each copy says it is copying, ends saying Copied, and leaves a file on the clipboard that runs as long as the cut, not the recording.

steps.note: Current's recording window had Copy Video and Copy GIF for pasting a trimmed recording into a chat. Next opens a recording in the editor, where the only way out was exporting a file. Edit > Copy Video (control shift command C) and Copy as GIF (control shift command G) put the edit itself on the clipboard
The eight second recording cut at the middle and the second half thrown away: the edit runs four seconds
The pill at the foot of the canvas says Copied and names the file a paste will carry
